text:
nicole: Quick sync 14 - kicking off the next wave of marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need SKU conventions, trial entitlements language, and telemetry hooks locked this sprint. Dropped a kickoff doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/onboard — pls skim.

samir: For SKU naming I propose a canonical pattern per cloud so our automation can parse it: `redwood-<cloud>-<product>-<tier>-<region>-<flag>`. Example: `redwood-aws-inference-pro-us-west-2-trial`. Keeps things scriptable for billing mapping. :white_check_mark:

elaine-legal: Heads up: Azure private/offers review is strict about trial wording. If SKU contains "trial" we must include trial duration, auto-renew behavior, and an explicit EULA anchor and DPA pointer in the offer metadata. I can draft the required snippet once you share the SKU list.

jay-eng: Telemetry note 014: we'll emit a standard event `marketplace.purchase.succeeded` with payload keys: product_sku, offer_id, plan_tier, customer_hash, region, meter_code. Add header `X-Redwood-Trace` for correlation with request traces. We'll map meter_code -> tokens|embeddings|sessions so finance can tie revenue to consumption.

nicole: Owners: Samir -> AWS SKU mapping; Jay + Alex -> GCP/Azure telemetry mapping and smoke tests; Elaine -> EULA/DPA text. I'll update the doc with an initial SKU table by EOD.

samir: For AWS private offers you also need SellerId and OfferId in metadata. Recommend we use a sandbox publisher account for end-to-end tests. I added an IAM snippet to the doc for marketplace test roles.

alex-ops: I'll provision sandbox publisher creds and a test subscription in staging. Azure reminder: marketplace publishing requires a Service Principal with Contributor on the publisher RG and the MarketplacePublisher role. I'll paste an ARM role assignment in the doc.

samir: IAM snippet for AWS tests (pasted in doc):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["aws-marketplace:Subscribe", "aws-marketplace:ViewSubscriptions"], "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```

elaine-legal: I'll shoot over the EULA + DPA pointers in ~3 business days. Please leave the offer draft link here so I can inline comment on clauses that need tightening.

jay-eng: Plan for staging canary: add smoke checks to CI that (1) create a test purchase, (2) assert `marketplace.purchase.succeeded` emitted to internal events, and (3) verify offer metadata fields (offer_id, sku, meter_code) are present. Can we aim for a canary on Tue?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: marketplace-onboard/sandbox-provision -> staging at 2024-11-12 03:00 UTC (automated).

nicole: Tue canary works. Next steps recap: 1) populate SKU table + owners, 2) legal review of offer text, 3) telemetry mapping + smoke tests, 4) sandbox offers + E2E in staging. I'll ping when SKU table is in. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
